title: Docket coverage and case posture
launch_mode: Explicit user run; no scheduler or upload listener installed

table_columns.label: Docket number
table_columns.description: Exact docket number, separate for every proceeding.

table_columns.label: Entry id
table_columns.description: Provider or source entry identity; not a cross-docket key by itself.

table_columns.label: Filed date
table_columns.description: Filing date as recorded, without guessing missing timezone.

table_columns.label: Record kind
table_columns.description: Motion, order, notice, exhibit or other documented type.

table_columns.label: Document status
table_columns.description: Retrieved and read, metadata only, unread, failed, restricted or unavailable.

table_columns.label: Effect and scope
table_columns.description: Source-supported procedural effect and affected issue/proceedings.

table_columns.label: Supersedes row ids
table_columns.description: Prior rows affected by an expressly supported amendment or vacatur.

table_columns.label: Capture as of
table_columns.description: Actual retrieval/snapshot time, distinct from filing date.

actions.label: Run scoped analysis
actions.requires: Verified host agent and source adapters

actions.label: Open source
actions.requires: Authorized source resolver and safe viewer

actions.label: Export draft table
actions.requires: Bound artifact writer with source rights and spreadsheet-cell sanitization

accessibility: Semantic table with keyboard-accessible source links
Status labels in text, not color alone
Announce progress and errors; preserve focus when results refresh
